campaign.title: M1 lower-cone t=1 squarefree gcd-lift joint-energy gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary large-sieve, Farey-fraction, additive-character, squarefree-correlation, and Kloosterman-fraction sources only after deriving the exact lcm collapse, gcd-lift coefficient, d-dependent profile, reduced phase, diagonal norm, and R-M-D-E-Q target. Record theorem numbers, coefficient independence, modulus and denominator ranges, spacing or clustering hypotheses, diagonal terms, smoothness, and every translated loss.

frozen_target.question: After summing the Round-148 Mobius cells with the same lcm and then every gcd lift with the same reduced fraction ell/q=L/q_0, does the exact compressed coefficient satisfy a uniform square norm and does its complete joint d-energy satisfy E_U<<R^2 D X^epsilon, thereby proving |T|<<RD X^epsilon; if not, what is the first exact cutoff, d-dependence, alignment, near-collision, source-hypothesis, boundary, or all-scale obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let C_d(n)=sum_{b|d,[alpha^2,b]=n}mu(alpha)mu(b), with odd squarefree alpha,b and the exact nonempty-progression indicator kappa_(d,U)(n). For ell=gL, q=gq_0, (L,q_0)=1, define B_(d,U)(L)=sum_g C_d(gL)kappa_(d,U)(gL)/g. The candidate exact row is G_U(d)=sum_((L,q_0)=1) chi_4(Lq_0)B_(d,U)(L)W_(d,U)(L/q_0)e(NdL/q_0)/L, supported on q_0 asymp LQ, and T=sum_d mu^2(d)(D/d)G_U(d). The target follows from sum_d mu^2(d)|G_U(d)|^2<<R^2 D X^epsilon.
quantities: For d_o=d/(d,2), prove locally that C_d(n)=mu(u)mu(v) for n=uv^2, odd u|d_o, odd u,v with mu^2(uv)=1, and (v,d)=1, and is zero otherwise; the odd p|d_o, p^2|n cancellation is compulsory and p=2 is absent from the lcm ledger.
The exact prefix indicator kappa_(d,U)(n) is finite and may be irregular near the endpoint. No continuous cutoff may silently replace it.
The chi_4 factors of the common odd gcd lift cancel as chi_4(g)^2=1, while the phase and saddle profile depend only on L/q_0. Every other g-dependence must be displayed.
Test the uniform truncated-lift norm sum_L |B_(d,U)(L)|^2/L<<X^epsilon before invoking the joint energy.
The literal equal-cell diagonal should cost DQX^epsilon and is target-safe because Q<=R^2; prove this with the actual d-dependent coefficient.
The off-diagonal must retain Delta=L_1q_(0,2)-L_2q_(0,1), the congruence NDelta=0 mod q_(0,1)q_(0,2), near alignments, common divisors, and imprimitive reductions.
A classical large sieve with d-independent coefficients does not apply verbatim to B_(d,U)(L)W_(d,U)(L/q_0).
Audit D=1, L=1, q_0|N, odd primes dividing d_o, even squarefree d, small reduced denominators, balanced and extreme aspects, short prefixes, and every M<=R^2.
The Round-147 H correlation is an alternative only after exact Euler recombination; no termwise lcm-to-powerful-index map is allowed.
Every t>=2 layer and the independent Round-138 cross owner remain separate.

completion_criteria: Derive the exact lcm-compressed coefficient C_d(n), including every odd-prime local case and the nonempty-progression cutoff.
Prove the finite gcd-lift regrouping ell=gL, q=gq_0 as an identity for the actual phase, chi_4 factors, profile, prefix, and amplitude.
Prove or refute the uniform truncated-lift square norm sum_L |B_(d,U)(L)|^2/L<<X^epsilon.
Write the exact joint d-energy and prove the literal diagonal is within R^2D X^epsilon.
Control or isolate the off-diagonal determinant, exact N-dependent alignments, near collisions, common divisors, imprimitive denominators, and d-dependent coefficients.
Source-audit every imported rational large-sieve, Farey, squarefree additive, Kloosterman-fraction, or dispersion theorem against the literal compressed energy.
Audit all R-M-D-E-Q aspects, D=1, L=1, q_0|N, small denominators, odd primes dividing d_o, even squarefree d, short prefixes, and boundary terms.
Prove the target, isolate a strict owner-complete range, or identify a rigorous gcd-lift energy no-go without converting an adverse upper capacity into a signed lower bound.
Close under exactly one label: euler_compressed_reciprocal_target, strict_joint_energy_range, or gcd_lift_energy_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: The exact C_d(n) formula, odd p|d_o square cancellation, absent p=2 lcm factor, squarefree conditions, parity, and prefix indicator are independently checked.
The ell=gL, q=gq_0 regrouping retains the chi_4 factors, phase, profile, support, finite cutoff, and every lift exactly.
The truncated B_(d,U) square norm and literal joint-energy diagonal are proved uniformly for every prefix and aspect.
Distinct fractions, exact N-dependent alignments, near collisions, common divisors, imprimitive denominators, and d-dependent coefficients are all priced.
Every imported theorem matches the actual coefficient and averaging family, and every R-M-D-E-Q range has a complete power ledger.
No t>=2, Round-138 cross, lower GAR, M1, M2, endpoint, M9, bridge, target, or exponent claim is promoted without its separate owner.
